resource_id.description: The UUID for the resource that was interacted with.  Only set if the logged interaction relates to a specific resource with a UUID.

resource_type.description: The type of resource that was interacted with.

log_level.description:
The type of the configuration option.
* `info`
* `debug`
* `warning`
* `error`
* `critical`

message.description: A message relating to the event that is being logged.

timestamp.description: The UTC timestamp of the time at which the log was generated.

metadata.description: A set of data that is specific to the logged event.  The properties of this object can varry depending on the source of the log.

user_id.description: The UUID for the user who triggered the event that is being logged.

ip_address.description: The IP address from which the request that generated the log originated.

username.description:
The email address of a user who is logging in.
*This field is only included in the metadata for logs relating to users logging in.*

http_status_code.description:
The status code returned for and API request.
*This field is only included in the metadata for logs relating to API requests.*

method.description:
The HTTP request method of the API request being logged.
*This field is only included in the metadata for logs relating to API requests.* * `GET` * `POST` * `PUT` * `PATCH` * `DELETE`

request_path.description:
The URI path of the API request being logged.
*This field is only included in the metadata for logs relating to API requests.*

request_body.description:
The request body provided for the API request being logged.
*This field is only included in the metadata for logs relating to API requests.*

query_parameters.description:
The query string provided for the API request being logged.
*This field is only included in the metadata for logs relating to API requests.*
